import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long r = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = r;
        }
        return a;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scan = new Scanner(System.in);
        int a = scan.nextInt();
        int b = scan.nextInt();
        int n = scan.nextInt();
        
        int px = 0, py = 0;
        double best = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        
        for (long j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            long base = (j * a) / b;
            for (long i = base - 1; i <= base + 1; ++i) {
                double cur = Math.abs((double)i / (double)j - (double)a / (double)b);
                if (cur < best) {
                    best = cur;
                    px = (int)i;
                    py = (int)j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        long g = gcd(px, py);
        System.out.println((px / g) + "/" + (py / g));
        scan.close();
    }
}
